verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a legal-services platform that offers customizable legal documents, so contract approval workflows are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack shows no configurable approval routing or pre-signature workflow. The evidence covers business formation, registered agent, compliance reminders, document templates and storage, none of which is an approval workflow.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can route contracts through configurable approval workflows before signature
